title: Skipjack tuna bone derived biocalcium ameliorates C2C12 myotube atrophy through microRNA29b regulation.
authors: Jantarawong, Sompot; Senphan, Theeraphol; Youngruk, Chanokwanan; Thongchai, Nicha; Watcharanurak, Papitchaya; Satrimafitrah, Pasjan; Yamaguchi, Yuya; Hasegawa, Kazuya; Pengjam, Yutthana
one_liner_zh: 研究金枪鱼骨生物钙对C2C12肌管萎缩的保护作用，涉及microRNA-29b调控，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为RNA-蛋白，与本课题无关。
abstract: We investigated the protective effects of skipjack tuna (Katsuwonus pelamis) bone-derived biocalcium (Bio) against dexamethasone-induced atrophy in C2C12 myotubes. Bio rescued atrophic morphology, increasing myotube diameter dose-dependently. It mitigated inflammation by suppressing nitric oxide production and the expression and concentration of proinflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta) significantly and dose-dependently. Bio restored protein turnover balance by downregulating MuRF1 and atrogin-1 while upregulating MTOR. At 5-20 microg/mL, Bio downregulated total NF-kappaB p65, p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK), and FoxO3a and upregulated Akt expression. Crucially, Bio dose-dependently downregulated primary-, precursor-, and mature-microRNA-29b. In Bio-treated, dexamethasone-treated C2C12 myotubes, microRNA-29b inhibitor co-transfection significantly increased myogenin and MyoD expression, whereas microRNA-29b mimic co-transfection suppressed these myogenic markers, confirming the inhibitory role of microRNA-29b. Molecular docking simulations confirmed strong binding affinities between microRNA-29b and myogenin/MyoD. These results demonstrate that Bio exerts anti-atrophy effects by disrupting the microRNA-29b-mediated block on myogenesis and modulating inflammatory responses, protein turnover, and key signaling pathways. Collectively, skipjack tuna-derived Bio shows promise as a functional food supplement for sarcopenia prevention and management.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了鲣鱼（Katsuwonus pelamis）骨来源的生物钙（Bio）对地塞米松诱导的C2C12肌管萎缩的保护作用。Bio挽救了萎缩形态，剂量依赖性地增加肌管直径。它通过抑制一氧化氮产生以及促炎细胞因子（IL-6、TNF-α、IL-1β）的表达和浓度，显著且剂量依赖性地减轻炎症。Bio通过下调MuRF1和atrogin-1，同时上调MTOR，恢复蛋白质周转平衡。在5-20微克/毫升浓度下，Bio下调总NF-κB p65、p38丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）和FoxO3a，并上调Akt表达。关键的是，Bio剂量依赖性地下调初级、前体和成熟microRNA-29b。在经Bio处理、地塞米松处理的C2C12肌管中，microRNA-29b抑制剂共转染显著增加myogenin和MyoD表达，而microRNA-29b模拟物共转染抑制这些生肌标志物，证实了microRNA-29b的抑制作用。分子对接模拟确认了microRNA-29b与myogenin/MyoD之间的强结合亲和力。这些结果表明，Bio通过破坏microRNA-29b介导的生肌阻断，并调节炎症反应、蛋白质周转和关键信号通路，发挥抗萎缩作用。总体而言，鲣鱼来源的Bio作为功能性食品补充剂，在预防和管理肌少症方面显示出潜力。
